test_title: PYST 28: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 2 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: ‘a picture is worth a thousand words’ means that:

options.text: pictures express more effectively than verbal descriptions
it takes a lot of words to describe any complex picture
words are more descriptive than pictures
detailed descriptions can enhance the value of a picture

solution:
The correct answer is option 1) i.e. **'****pictures express more effectively than verbal descriptions'.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **first sentence of the first paragraph** says " a picture is worth a thousand words..."
 
• From the above sentence, we can say that **a picture contains various important information and it can be interpreted from many different perspectives.**

 

Hence, the only possible answer is option 1.
